description: Open a batch of many prompts on OpenVibe.AI (POST /api/v1/batches) and cancel one (POST /api/v1/batches/:id/cancel). A batch is answered later, through a provider's own batch API when there is one, and is billed at half the retail price. A first-party service needs this grant to open a batch on the network's own account; a person or a developer app pays with its own account.
